action.text: Task: Two optimized builds changed behavior (arithmetic error; complex vs real). Bug in compiler/unary.py: visit_UnaryOp returns node.operand for both UAdd AND USub, dropping negation. Fix: UAdd on int/float literal→operand; USub on int/float literal→Constant(-value); all other cases→keep UnaryOp. Steps: 1) Read OBS-0002, OBS-0003 for emitted trees, 2) Fix unary.py, 3) Write reports/incident.json, 4) Run public check, 5) Submit.
